name: treg
description: Search a catalog of external data tools and generative models from Copilot and call them through one hosted MCP server: SEO and SERP data, people and company enrichment, ad libraries, social and web data, image and video generation, plus the API keys your team registered. Sign-in is OAuth. Calls on treg's keys spend a prepaid treg balance; calls on your own keys are not billed.
